name: lovable
description: Drive Lovable from Cursor: create projects, send work to the Lovable agent, manage Lovable Cloud databases, and deploy, all through the Lovable MCP server.

skills.name: enable-lovable-cloud-database
skills.description: Provision and inspect a Lovable Cloud Postgres database, and run SQL safely. Use when a project needs data, or when you need to read or fix rows directly.

skills.name: deploy-lovable-project
skills.description: Publish a Lovable project and confirm the live deployment, then check basic traffic. Use when someone wants the app shipped or wants to see how a deployed app is doing.

skills.name: iterate-with-lovable-agent
skills.description: Make changes to an existing Lovable project by messaging its agent, then verify the result in the diff. Use for any edit, fix, or refinement on a project that already exists.

skills.name: scaffold-lovable-project
skills.description: Start a new Lovable app from a plain-language brief and hand back the editor and preview links. Use when someone wants to spin up a fresh project.

rules.name: cloud-database
rules.description: Safe handling of Lovable Cloud (Postgres) when using enable_database and query_database

rules.name: lovable-workflow
rules.description: How to drive a Lovable project from Cursor through the Lovable MCP tools

commands.name: lovable-db
commands.description: Provision or inspect a project's Lovable Cloud database and run read queries safely.

commands.name: lovable-deploy
commands.description: Publish the current Lovable project and return the live URL after confirming the build.

commands.name: lovable-iterate
commands.description: Send a change to an existing Lovable project's agent and verify it in the diff.

commands.name: lovable-new
commands.description: Create a new Lovable project from a one-line brief and return the editor and preview links.
